message: I remember the last time the power went out, my friend Sarah called me in a panic, convinced we were headed for the Stone Age. While I was rummaging through my drawer for flashlights and power banks, I couldn’t help but chuckle. I told her, "Hey, we’ve got this! Just think of it as an adventure." We ended up gathering snacks, lighting up the living room with lanterns, and sharing stories by flashlight. It was a cozy reminder that a little prep can turn a potential hassle into a fun memory. What’s your go-to way to stay calm during a blackout?
